procedures.name: UpsertInventoryItem
procedures.body:
IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM InventoryItems WHERE CharacterUID = @CharacterUID AND ItemID = @ItemID)
BEGIN
    UPDATE InventoryItems
    SET Count = Count + @AddCount
    WHERE CharacterUID = @CharacterUID AND ItemID = @ItemID;

    DELETE FROM InventoryItems
    WHERE CharacterUID = @CharacterUID AND ItemID = @ItemID AND Count <= 0;
END
ELSE
BEGIN
    IF @AddCount > 0
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO InventoryItems (CharacterUID, ItemID, Count)
        VALUES (@CharacterUID, @ItemID, @AddCount);
    END
END
